summary.text: Terry Spilsbury, listed by Ballotpedia as Walter Spilsbury, is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives representing Sullivan 3 who is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney by training and a former maritime counsel on the U.S. Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, & Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Terry Spilsbury was born in New York, New York, and graduated from Huntington High School.
He earned a B.A. in political science and environmental studies from Bowdoin College in 1976, a J.D. from the University of Washington in 1980, and an M.B.A. from Columbia University in 1992.

His career experience includes working as a maritime counsel on the U.S. Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, & Transportation, an associate attorney, a marketing director with Sea-Land Service, and an independent financial consultant.
Spilsbury has chaired the Charlestown Heritage Commission, the Charlestown School Withdrawal Study Committee, and the Charlestown Planning Board.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2020, and his current term began on December 7, 2022.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
